veranderings.blok: Gumboot-dans: hoe dit lyk en klink
veranderings.rede: 'Hande klap' is the idiomatic form and avoids repeating 'hulle hande' from the same sentence.

veranderings.voor: want gumboots is die Engelse woord
veranderings.rede: A word cited as a word is marked with quotation marks.
'n dans dans' is a clumsy repetition; 'uitvoer' keeps the meaning.
'Opgemaakte' echoes English 'made-up'; 'versinde' is the standard Afrikaans word.

veranderings.na: soos daardie karakter dit sou doen.
veranderings.rede: Ending on a bare 'sou' copies English ellipsis ('as that character would'); Afrikaans needs the verb.

veranderings.voor: en antwoord die groep se vrae
veranderings.na: en beantwoord die groep se vrae
veranderings.rede: With a direct object the verb is 'beantwoord'; 'antwoord' takes 'op'.

vlae.blok: Gumboot-dans: hoe dit lyk en klink
vlae.teks: Dan volg die span dikwels die maat wat die musikante speel.
vlae.rede: 'Maat' here means the beat or tempo, but a protected entry notes that in music 'maat' is a group of beats and the glossary uses 'maat' for a partner; whether 'ritme' is meant is a content choice, so not changed.
